chunks.title: EDD Policy
chunks.text: Enhanced due diligence escalation list. Escalate to EDD: money services businesses, casinos and dealers in precious metals. Business types not on this escalation list follow standard onboarding.

chunks.title: EDD Policy
chunks.text: Amended July 2026. Escalate to EDD: money services businesses, casinos, dealers in precious metals and virtual asset service providers, including custody and exchange businesses.

chunks.title: Risk Rating Guide
chunks.text: Score customer risk from 0 to 100. Bands: 0 to 39 low, 40 to 69 medium, 70 to 100 high. Business types on the EDD escalation list score at least 70.

chunks.title: KYC Procedure
chunks.text: Standard onboarding: verify registration documents against the state business registry and screen every beneficial owner against sanctions lists.
